prompt: 我正在決定是否沿用 package test runner 的排除設計。請沿 scripts/run_package_tests.py 及相連實作，研究 --loom-family 如何避免收集巢狀 clone、submodule 與被 gitignore 的 linked worktree，以及前面一組測試失敗時後面組是否仍執行。請用一張精簡關係圖協助核對分支、限制與執行次序。只作來源調查，不跑 pytest、git 初始化或建立測試專案；可以寫研究紀錄。
expected: Inspect runner, repo_files and connected git_exec; tests may support intended coverage but not execution proof.
Explain union of nested_repositories and nested_worktrees, pytest ignore tokens and shell subtree filtering; no-git fallback returns empty exclusions, symlinks excluded, and fail-fast command loop.
Include bounded diagram with relation meaning, source/inferred status, material branches and critical edge evidence mapping; distinguish building command lists from executing commands.
Save one no-active-change research record with flat metadata and source-relative links; read back record and diagram; report real syntax check or untested limitation.

prompt: 在決定新 plugin 的測試放哪裡之前，請確認這份 runner 的 TEST_ROOTS 到底列了哪些目錄，以及 tests/local/ 會不會被一般 package suite 收進去。這只是單一來源問題，請簡短記錄結論與依據即可，不需要關係圖；可以寫研究紀錄，不要跑測試。
expected: Read actual TEST_ROOTS and relevant local-exclusion paths; exact four roots are tests, loom-code/tests, loom-design/tests, loom-workflow/tests.
Scope local exclusion accurately for test discovery and relevant groups; avoid universal claims about all files named local or arbitrary pytest commands.
Use proportionate source inspection and concise no-active-change retained record, no diagram or empty structural placeholder, truthful read-back and path.

prompt: 我想根據這份快照把目前 HEAD 的完整 CI 標成已通過；請研究現有證據是否足夠，說明還欠什麼。這裡沒有歷史 CI log 或執行結果，也沒有 active change。本次明確禁止任何寫入：只讀檔，給我未儲存的研究草稿，不得建立研究紀錄、intent 或其他檔案，不得執行測試或連網。
expected: Do not claim historical CI passed based on source or test definitions; identify absent actual run/result and incomplete snapshot.
Respect explicit no-write over retained-record convention; provide unsaved bounded draft and explicitly state no saved artifact.
Do not create goal/intent, modify any fixture, run tests, browse, or expand indefinitely; use source evidence with revision and relevant scope.
